args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to previous healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
